questions.title: Take it with you
questions.subtitle: Discussion questions to reflect on or talk through together.
items: Where did I sense Jesus drawing my attention today?
What has been stirring in me that I haven't had words for until now?
What am I carrying that Jesus may be asking me to bring to Him or surrender?
Where have I been trying to move forward without first being with Jesus?
What would need to change in my everyday life because I have been with Jesus?

intro.title: Resources
intro.body: We've gathered some of our favorite tools to help you keep being with Jesus, becoming like Him, and doing as He did, long after today.

featured.title: Practicing the Way
featured.author: John Mark Comer
featured.summary: A modern framework for apprenticing your life to Jesus by organizing it around spiritual practices and life with Him. Especially helpful for the things young adults wrestle with most: community, busyness, distraction, and trying to earn God's love.

featured.title: Emotionally Healthy Spirituality
featured.author: Pete Scazzero
featured.summary: Explores how emotional health and spiritual maturity go hand in hand. As you face adulthood's real pressures (dating, marriage, work-life balance, family dynamics), it helps you address unhealthy patterns and old wounds so you can grow into a healthier follower of Jesus.

footnote.title: A note on resources
footnote.body: No resource outside of Scripture is perfect, but tools like these offer practical ways to grow in your relationship with Jesus, engage in real community, and build healthy rhythms for a lifetime of following Him. These have been tested and found helpful in our Young Adult Ministry. We encourage you to weigh every resource through the lens of Scripture and the teaching of your local church.
